name: atlas
description: ATLAS — AI Intelligence & Investigation Platform (Phase 1 foundation)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @atlas/shared && npm run build -w @atlas/api && npm run build -w @atlas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @atlas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @atlas/api && npm run typecheck -w @atlas/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @atlas/api && npm run lint -w @atlas/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @atlas/shared && npm run test -w @atlas/shared && npm run test -w @atlas/api && npm run test -w @atlas/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @atlas/shared && npm run test:unit -w @atlas/api
scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run build
